description: This bar chart illustrates the bias percentages associated with different contact scenarios—Support of Authorities, Extended Contact, and Virtual Contact—categorized by contact history. The horizontal axis displays the contact scenarios: “Support of Authorities,” “Extended Contact,” and “Virtual Contact,” in that order, and is labeled with categorical data. The vertical axis, labeled “Bias Percentage,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  Each contact scenario has three bars representing different contact conditions: “No Contact Before” (light blue), “Positive Contact Before” (red), and “Negative Contact Before” (dark blue/hatched). For “Support of Authorities,” the “No Contact Before” bar is approximately 39.50, the “Positive Contact Before” bar is 0.04, and the “Negative Contact Before” bar is 0.00.  For “Extended Contact,” the “No Contact Before” bar is approximately 40.61, the “Positive Contact Before” bar is 0.11, and the “Negative Contact Before” bar is 0.00. For “Virtual Contact,” the “No Contact Before” bar is approximately 39.74, the “Positive Contact Before” bar is 10.01, and the “Negative Contact Before” bar is 10.02. The bars are grouped by contact scenario, with each group containing one bar for each contact condition. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
